Hi, this is Megan from Artesian Street. Wondering if you would be interested in working together on a Detroit Public Library educational event - I think they would be interested and the Redford branch is nearby. It could be good indirect advertising, like a “conversation with a pharmacist (and Megan)”, but of course I don’t know what attendance would be like. My public health research focuses on climate change, and there’s a lot that could be shared about medication/chronic health condition safety in heatwaves. Here are some of the resources I like. https://www.safemedication.com/pharmacist-insights/2021/preparing-your-medications-for-emergencies 

https://yaleclimateconnections.org/2022/07/common-medications-may-increase-the-dangers-of-heat-waves/ (beautiful infographic)

https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0243665

https://www.cdc.gov/caregiving/media/pdfs/Complete-Care-Plan-Form-5081.pdf

https://www.medicare.gov/publications/11377-getting-care-and-drugs-in-a-disaster-or-emergency.pdf

https://thefederalregister.org/pdf/documents/2016-28297.pdf (If I’m reading this correctly, pharmacies can waive copay/deductible/coinsurance for federal program beneficiaries at their discretion during natural disasters - very interested to hear what you know about this).
Hello, would it be possible to order a sodium alginate supplement for heartburn?
do you have this in stock?
